This made her the first character in ''RuneScape 2'' to change gender, followed by the [[Make-over Mage]] in 2005 and the [[Oracle]] in 2007. *She is sometimes referred to as '''Survival Guide''' during the tutorial. {{Tutorial Island}} {{Tutors}}
